description: Publish one post to up to 4 accounts on Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram and Discord in one call, with images, alt text and automatic threads for long text, using your own credentials (never stored). Use when the user asks to post or cross-post something to Bluesky, Mastodon, a Telegram channel or group, or a Discord channel. Each target carries its own credentials: bluesky {handle, appPassword}, mastodon {instance, accessToken}, telegram {botToken, chatId}, discord {webhookUrl}. Credentials are used for this call only and are never stored or logged. Long text becomes a thread of replies where the network has threads (thread: false fails it instead). Returns published, failed and results[] {network, ok, url, id, posts[], parts, error}. Charged once per call when at least one network accepted the post. Does not post to X, Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn or TikTok; use social_format to prepare text for those. Price: $0.001 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls, no wallet needed.

alt.description: Alt text per image, same order

hashtags.description: Hashtags to append, with or without #

images.description: Up to 4 public image URLs (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP; Bluesky up to ~950 KB each)

link.description: A link to append after the text

targets.description: Where to post: up to 4 accounts, one entry each

accessToken.description: Mastodon: access token with write:statuses (and write:media for images), from Preferences > Development

appPassword.description: Bluesky: an app password (Settings > Privacy and security > App passwords), not your main password

botToken.description: Telegram: bot token from @BotFather (the bot must be an admin of the channel)

maxChars.description: Mastodon: your server's character limit when it is not 500

service.description: Bluesky: PDS URL for self-hosted accounts (default https://bsky.social)

username.description: Discord: display name for the message

webhookUrl.description: Discord: channel webhook URL (Channel settings > Integrations > Webhooks)

text.description: The post text (long text becomes a thread where the network has threads)

thread.description: Split long text into a thread of replies (default true); false fails a post that is too long

name: social_publish

results.description: One per target, in input order

error.description: Why this network failed; credentials are never echoed

posts.description: Every post made (several for a thread)

url.description: Link to the first post, when the network gives one

title: Publish a social post
